input: Replace the worn-out running shoes this week

gold.taskTitle: Replace worn-out running shoes this week
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to buy a new pair of running shoes to replace their current worn-out pair within this week.

questions.title: What type of running do you mainly do?
questions.description: Understand whether the user runs on roads, trails, tracks, or a mix, to guide shoe selection.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred shoe brand or model?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to repurchase the same shoe or is open to trying something new.

questions.title: What is your budget for the new pair?
questions.description: Establish a price range to narrow down options effectively.

questions.title: Will you shop in-store, online, or either?
questions.description: Determine the shopping channel to plan the steps involved in the purchase.

questions.title: Do you have any fit issues like wide feet or arch needs?
questions.description: Identify any special sizing or support requirements that affect which shoes to consider.

questions.title: Which specific day this week works for buying?
questions.description: Pin down a target day so the task has a concrete deadline within the week.

questions.title: Are there stores near you that stock running shoes?
questions.description: Confirm local availability or identify whether the user needs to travel or rely on online delivery.
